clues.text: Married to a harsh and evil Calebite, this woman was described as intelligent and beautiful.
She hurried to load donkeys with bread, wine, five sheep, raisins and fig cakes to take to David.
When she met David and his armed men in the wilderness, she quickly got off her donkey and fell facedown before him.
She told David to pay no attention to her husband, because his name means Fool and he lived up to it.
David blessed her discernment because she kept him from bloodshed and from avenging himself by his own hand.
Once widowed, she rode a donkey with five of her maidens, following David's messengers to become his wife.
She and Ahinoam of Jezreel, David's two wives, were carried off captive by raiders while David was away.
